summary: Modal panel that slides in from an edge of the screen; with placement="bottom" it works as a bottom sheet.
whenToUse: Content taller than a dialog that benefits from keeping the page context.

props.name: placement
props.description: Entry edge; start/end follow the writing direction.

keyboard.action: Focus is contained within the panel.
Closes and returns focus to the trigger.

accessibility: Semantics and focus management identical to a modal Dialog.
responsive: Limited width on desktop, nearly full width on mobile; the bottom sheet has a maximum height and internal scrolling.
commonMistakes: Using fixed left/right: use start/end to support RTL.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled with description and long content
examples.description: isOpen + onOpenChange without DialogTrigger; long lines wrap inside the panel.

examples.name: NestedConfirm
examples.title: AlertDialog nested in the panel
examples.description: The destructive confirmation opens on top of the Drawer; with Annulla or Esc, focus returns to the Rimuovi button in the panel.
